intro: Jobs similar to general pediatricians are other primary care and advanced practice roles. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Nurse Practitioners (86% similar), Physician Assistants (85%) and Family Medicine Physicians (85%). 19 of the 20 are in the same health field.
shared: These careers share checkups, routine care, clear talks with families and long-term relationships with patients. O*NET rates judgment and decision making at 4.25 out of 5 for pediatricians, and complex problem solving and social perceptiveness at 4. Family medicine, internal medicine and nurse practitioner work use the same mix. All 20 need graduate training, and 7 pay more than the $210,040 pediatrician median.

faq.q: Which jobs like pediatrician pay more?
faq.a: 7 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Emergency Medicine Physicians earn $335,550 (60% more), Dermatologists $328,730 (57% more) and Obstetricians and Gynecologists $292,910 (39% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. Each needs its own residency after medical school.

faq.q: Is a nurse practitioner similar to a pediatrician?
faq.a: Yes. Nurse Practitioners are the closest match at 86% similar, and many specialize in pediatrics. They earn $132,300, which is 37% less than general pediatricians, and train through nursing and a graduate program instead of medical school and a residency, which is a much shorter path.
